rows.text: The Prime Minister's Office release of 17 March 2020, a reply to a press release of the Paati Temokalati 'Otumotu Anga'ofa (PTOA), states that the PTOA party has not yet registered as the law requires, up to that day ('oku te'eki ke lesisita 'a e Paati PTOA 'o fakatatau ki he tu'utu'uni 'a e LAO, 'o a'u ki he 'aho ni), and that it has no legal body and no constitution ('oku 'ikai ke 'i ai ha sino fakalao mo ha'anau Konisitutone).
